inline.headline: Filter day, without the guesswork.
inline.text: Snap your pool equipment in Jib and it plans the backwash and filter clean in the right order, and reminds you through the swimming season.
inline.alt: A flat blue pool backwash hose running into a round grated drain on the concrete in a side yard, beside a brick wall

jobs.title: Backwash the sand filter to the gully
jobs.description: Into the overflow gully, never the stormwater drain or the street.
directions: Turn the pump off and set the valve to backwash
Run the hose to the overflow gully
Pump until the sight glass runs clear
Rinse for 30 seconds, then back to filter

jobs.title: Check the pool gate latches by itself
Test the water before the weekend

end.headline: Clear water, clear rules.
end.alt: A clear blue backyard pool in late afternoon sun behind a glass pool fence, with towels and a sun hat on a lounge

jobs.title: Clean the filter before summer
jobs.description: Backwash, then check the sand is still doing its job.
directions: Backwash and rinse the filter
Note the pressure gauge reading
Look for sand in the pool after backwashing
Ask a pool shop to check old sand

jobs.title: Clear leaves from the skimmer basket
Check the gully grate isn't blocked

inline.headline: Ready for the first sausage.
inline.text: Snap your barbecue in Jib and it plans the gas check and the deep clean, with the materials list, and reminds you every spring.
inline.alt: A white LPG gas bottle in the open cabinet under a stainless steel barbecue, its regulator joint dabbed with soapy water, a spray bottle on the deck

jobs.title: Soapy water test on the BBQ gas hose
jobs.description: Before the first cook of summer. Bubbles mean a leak.
directions: Turn the gas on at the bottle, burners off
Spray the joints and hose with soapy water
Watch for bubbles growing
Bubbles? Gas off, and replace the hose or regulator

jobs.title: Scrape and wash the hotplate
Empty and clean the fat tray

end.headline: Sausages, not smoke alarms.
end.alt: Sausages and onions cooking on the clean hotplate of a stainless steel barbecue on a back deck at dusk, string lights behind

jobs.title: Deep clean the BBQ before summer
jobs.description: Plates, grill, burners and the fat tray, in that order.
directions: Heat the plates for 10 minutes, then turn off
Scrape the plates and grill while warm
Wash the hood and plates with warm soapy water
Brush the burner holes clear and refit

jobs.title: Check the gas bottle's test date
Keep the BBQ a metre from the fence

inline.headline: Sweep, wash, sand, done.
inline.text: Snap the patio or driveway in Jib and it plans the clean in the right order, with the materials, and reminds you next year.
inline.alt: A grimy, mould-darkened paver driveway beside a brick house, with a broom against the wall and a yellow pressure washer by the garden tap

jobs.title: Pressure clean the driveway
jobs.description: Push the dirty water onto the lawn, not into the street.
directions: Sweep off the leaves and loose dirt
Wash with plain water at a low angle
Push the run-off onto the lawn or garden
Sweep joint sand back in once it's dry

jobs.title: Top up the joint sand
Clear the moss along the fence line

end.headline: Clean pavers, clean drains.
end.alt: A freshly cleaned sandstone-coloured paver patio behind a brick house, with a broom against the wall and an outdoor table and chairs

jobs.title: Sweep joint sand into the pavers
jobs.description: Fills the gaps so weeds and ants can't move in.
directions: Wait until the pavers are fully dry
Tip sand over the joints
Sweep it diagonally into the gaps
Sweep off the extra and hose lightly

jobs.title: Seal the pavers
Check the stormwater grate is clear

inline.headline: The right mesh, first trip.
inline.text: Snap the screen in Jib and it plans the fix with a shopping list, from the mesh roll to the spline size, so you buy it all in one trip.
inline.alt: A window fly screen frame on a garage workbench with new grey mesh fitted, a coil of black spline, a spline roller and a utility knife beside it

jobs.title: Re-mesh the bedroom fly screen
jobs.description: New mesh and spline. Take the old spline to match the size.
directions: Lift the screen out and lay it flat
Pull out the old spline and mesh
Roll new spline over the mesh into the channel
Trim the extra mesh with a sharp knife

jobs.title: Patch the small hole in the door screen
Check the screen clips

end.headline: Breeze in. Mozzies out.
end.alt: An open bedroom window with a new fly screen at dusk, a white sheer curtain blowing in and a bedside lamp on

jobs.title: Check every fly screen before summer
jobs.description: Tears, gaps at the edges and loose clips.
directions: Look at each screen against the light
Push on the edges for gaps
Note tears big and small
Add a fix job for each one

jobs.title: Tip out water in pot plant saucers
Patch the small tear by the latch

inline.headline: Prep, oil, wait, done.
inline.text: Snap your deck in Jib and it plans the job with the materials, the drying days and a reminder for the next coat.
inline.alt: A weathered grey timber deck freshly scrubbed and wet, with a deck brush, a blue bucket and a coiled garden hose

jobs.title: Clean the deck before oiling
jobs.description: Then let it dry for a couple of days before the oil goes on.
directions: Sweep and clear the gaps between boards
Wet the deck and apply the cleaner
Scrub along the boards and rinse well
Leave it to dry for a couple of days

jobs.title: Sand the rough spots
Punch down any raised nails

end.headline: Deck done before the guests.
end.alt: A freshly oiled timber deck glowing honey brown at golden hour, with an outdoor table, chairs and pot plants

jobs.title: Oil the deck
jobs.description: Thin coats along the boards, on a mild, dry day.
jobs.timeEstimate: Half a day, then drying time
directions: Check the forecast for dry days
Stir the oil well
Coat two or three boards at a time, along their length
Wait as long as the tin says before walking on it

jobs.title: Oil the steps
Move the pot plants back

inline.headline: Every hiding spot, on one list.
inline.text: Snap the yard, the shed and the woodpile in Jib and it plans the clean-up, the gaps to seal and the rat control, with dates.
inline.alt: Split firewood stacked on a raised black steel rack against a Colorbond fence, with bare concrete underneath

jobs.title: Stack the firewood off the ground
jobs.description: On a rack, away from the house, so nothing can live under it.
directions: Pick a spot away from the house and the back door
Set the rack on firm, level ground
Restack the wood on the rack
Sweep the old spot clear of bark and rubbish

jobs.title: Mow the lawn short along the fence
Clear the sheets of iron behind the shed

end.headline: Fewer places to hide.
end.alt: A black compost bin with its lid shut at the end of a tidy vegetable bed in a backyard

jobs.title: Swap the open compost heap for a closed bin
jobs.description: Food scraps feed rats, and rats bring snakes.
directions: Set the bin on bare ground or pavers
Move the old heap into it
Keep the lid shut
Keep pet food and seed in sealed tubs

jobs.title: Move the garden beds back from the house
Fit a seal under the back door
